verdicts.reason: Both break the product pairing the same way: the serum bottle shrinks to a tiny sliver in the bottom-left corner, the peach circle becomes a stray cropped blob in the bottom-right, and the jar floats alone, so the 'duo' imagery is lost. In A, the centred logo doesn't match the left-aligned text, but the headline and body copy have proper spacing between them. B pushes a small logo into the top-right corner away from the left-aligned column, jams the body copy against the headline, and leaves a dead gap between the jar and the CTA, so it is slightly worse.
